blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: decomposition — Split task into smaller problems.
top-down design — Start broad, refine into subtasks.

blocks.title: Define and predict
blocks.text: Decomposition divides a larger problem into manageable sub-problems whose inputs and outputs are clear.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: A top-down design begins with a main task, then refines it into independently testable functions or procedures.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Interfaces between subproblems matter: validation should happen before data are stored or a fee is charged.

blocks.title: Worked example · Follow the reasoning
blocks.text: State the interface for each subtask; every step has a specific responsibility.
